title: The Hard Drop
author: Rafael Okonkwo
blurb: Mara Iversen, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
